title: Legal pages and UU PDP compliance
description: Add Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, cookie consent banner with links from landing and signup
completion: Created /terms (Syarat Layanan) and /privacy (Kebijakan Privasi UU PDP compliant) pages in Bahasa Indonesia. Added cookie consent banner component (CookieConsent) with localStorage persistence, mounted in root layout. Updated landing page footer and sign-up consent with legal links. Privacy policy references UU No. 27/2022 (UU PDP): data collected, legal basis, purposes, third-party sharing, security, data subject rights, cross-border transfer, DPO contact.
